translations.web: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
translations.bsb: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger calms dispute.
translations.kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
translations.asv: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
